CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  2175 Cherry Avenue • Signal Hill, California 90755-3799

  MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  SIGNAL HILL CITY COUNCIL
  October 27, 2022

A Special Meeting of the Signal Hill City Council was held on October 27, 2022 at
approximately 11:30 a.m. at Signal HIll Public Library - Signal Point Terrace, 1800 E. Hill
Street, Signal Hill, California.

Mayor Jones and the City Council presented the City’s inaugural State of the City. The
presentation included discussions on the City’s efforts to serve the community; updates on
major projects; today’s business climate; and the City’s financial outlook.

The Special Meeting ended at approximately 1:10 p.m. The next regular meeting of the City
Council will be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022 at 7:00 p.m. (hybrid meeting format,
including in-person, and video and teleconference participation options). Instructions to
participate in the meeting will be provided on the meeting agenda.

  MAYOR JONES adjourned the meeting at approximately 1:10 p.m.

  _____________________________
  KEIR JONES
  MAYOR

  Attest:

  _____________________________
  CARMEN R. BROOKS
  CITY CLERK
